Fernwood Investment Management Has Decreased Its Holding in Safety Ins Group Com (SAFT) as Stock Price Declined; Firsthand Capital Management Has Trimmed Its Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) Position by $860,000; Market Valuation Rose 
April 21, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Fernwood Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in Safety Ins Group Inc Com (SAFT) by 47.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fernwood Investment Management Llc sold 5,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.34% with the market. The institutional investor held 6,250 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $502,000, down from 11,950 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fernwood Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Safety Ins Group Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.62% or $0.5 during the last trading session, reaching $80.7. About 16,482 shares traded. Safety Insurance Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:SAFT) has risen 10.76%   uptrending. It has underperformed by 0.79% the S&P500. 
Firsthand Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) by 12.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Firsthand Capital Management Inc sold 5,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 35,000 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.04 million, down from 40,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
